easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Boros Reckoner.
description:
Deal damage to Boros Reckoner
Fiendlash and Boros Reckoner trigger.
Resolve the Boros Reckoner trigger, dealing damage to any target
Resolve the Boros Reckoner trigger, dealing at least 1 damage to itself.
Repeat from step 2.
